caption:
Our snorkel mornings are planned around the tide.

We leave about 90 minutes before low tide, in a small group of up to six, with a PADI-certified instructor and all the equipment. No diving certification needed, and underwater photos and videos are included.

No rush. Just island time.

Ask us about the snorkel outing and we'll help you plan it with our local team. WhatsApp +55 75 99715-4100 · link in bio

#MorroDeSaoPaulo #IlhaDeTinhare #Snorkel #Bahia

campos.label: What to do
campos.title: A snorkel morning, *timed by the tide*
campos.subtitle: About three hours in a small group
campos.alt: Two people in wetsuits wading beside a boat with a blue canopy at low tide

campos.label: The tide
campos.title: The tide sets the *time*
campos.body: We leave about 90 minutes before low tide. The exact time changes every day, so we confirm it the day before.
campos.alt: A woman looking out over a flat beach at low tide, with the sky reflected in the water

campos.label: Where we start
campos.title: From *Third* or Fourth Beach
campos.body: The boat leaves from Third Beach or Fourth Beach, depending on the sea conditions.
campos.alt: A group walking across the sand toward the boats at low tide

campos.label: Small groups
campos.title: Never more than *six* people
campos.body: A small group means more time with your guide and more room in the water. The minimum age is 5.
campos.alt: Two people seated on a boat with a blue canopy

campos.label: No experience needed
campos.title: Snorkeling, *no certification* needed
campos.body: A PADI-certified instructor guides the outing, after a safety briefing. Knowing how to float helps, and shallow areas suit beginners and children.
campos.alt: A man adjusting his snorkel mask in the water

campos.label: In the water
campos.title: Natural pools and *coral*
campos.body: The outing visits natural pools and coral areas, with clear water and marine life to watch. The snorkeling equipment is included.
campos.alt: A person swimming with a snorkel in clear green water

campos.label: Memories
campos.title: Photos and videos *underwater*
campos.body: Underwater photos and videos are included, so you take the day home with you.
campos.alt: A guide and a guest smiling in the water

campos.label: Good to know
campos.title: If the sea says *not today*
campos.body: When weather or sea conditions are not safe, the outing can be rescheduled or refunded.

campos.title: Plan your day with people who *know the island*
campos.body: Ask us about the snorkel outing and we'll help you plan it with our local team.
